about: The fisher's and the river Digimon's lines in Central Park (named texts of this mod). English is required.

texts.intro:
Hi! I'm the fisher here.
I study the Digimon of this river.
texts.busy:
The fish aren't biting today...
Talk to me another time.
texts.request:
Have you seen MegaSeadramon? It lives in the deep part of the river.
Beat it and you'll get Betamon's DDNA.
Bring it to me and I'll give you Betamon!
texts.give:
That's Betamon's DDNA! You beat MegaSeadramon!
Then Betamon is yours. Take care of it!
You'll find it in the lab's partner list.
texts.already:
Betamon loves the water.
And it loves its Tamer even more!
texts.challenge:
A huge shadow rises from the water...
MegaSeadramon wants to test your team!
texts.defeated:
MegaSeadramon bows its head and sinks into the river.
It leaves behind a shimmering DDNA!
texts.gone: Only ripples are left on the water.
